statement: The recorded invoice is **not safe to pay**—it is a duplicate of a payment already made (PAY-2291 on 3 September). I will place it on hold.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer asserts the record's "unpaid, due" status is wrong—"not safe to pay—it is a duplicate of a payment already made (PAY-2291 on 3 September)."
